feat_id.description: Feature id for this run — REQUIRED. Drives the branch name (feat/<id>), the worktree dir (wt-<slug>), docs/adr/<id>.md in agent prompts, and the PR title. The worktree node fails fast when empty.

feat_description.description: One-paragraph feature description handed to every agent prompt and the PR body.

checkout.description: Local clone path lasius operates on (any checkout inside a lasius workspace). REQUIRED per run.

lasius_root.description: lasius workspace root (--root flag); repo args are checkout paths so any lasius.toml workspace works.

node_url.description: Base URL of `peregrin serve`/`peregrin-node` — agent steps POST /api/sessions/run here; bearer = PEREGRIN_TOKEN.

worktree_base.description: Feature worktrees land at <worktree_base>/<worktree_prefix>-<slug>; per-run review text at <worktree_base>/review-<slug>.txt.

worktree_prefix.description: Worktree dir prefix — final dir is <worktree_prefix>-<slug>.

branch_prefix.description: Branch prefix — the PR head branch is <branch_prefix>/<feat_id>.

pr_base.description: PR base branch — also the worktree --rev (origin/<pr_base>).

test_cmd.description: Test command run inside the worktree after impl and after each fix commit. Override per repo (e.g. "cargo test", "pytest").

agent.description: sepia agent-config id for all agent turns.

agent_mode.description: ACP session mode applied after create (session/set_mode). REQUIRED for unattended runs — devin's default accept-edits prompts on exec and deadlocks. 'bypass' auto-approves all tools; 'smart' auto-runs model-judged-safe actions; 'accept-edits' only auto-approves edits.
